data.name: NK Mane
data.player_statement:
A complete player, NK Mane has made a big mark in cricket. With 42 turns at the crease, they've hit a top score of 43*, with an average of 14.81 and a quick strike rate of 127.08. Their knack for hitting big shots is evident with 25 sixes and 37 fours.

Equally good at bowling, they've bowled 89.3 overs, taking 37 wickets at an economy rate of 8.57. Despite a few wides, their accuracy is top-notch, making them a key player for their team.
